traps.manipulated_variable: presence of a decisive discriminating test between two evidence-backed hypotheses
controlled_variables: number of memories per hypothesis (kept comparable)
source authority (both hypotheses have engineer-level observers)
traps.expected_behavior: Preserve both hypotheses as unresolved for the March 14/16 episode specifically; surface the 04-05 meeting note's 'probably electrical' lean as a stated belief, not as resolution.
traps.naive_failure: Select the electrical hypothesis because the 04-05 meeting summary sounds authoritative and confident, or because it has one more supporting memory.
traps.metric: Contention Preservation Rate; False Resolution Rate
traps.matched_control: control_A (C09) and control_C (C11) show what a genuinely resolved/consensus claim looks like by contrast.

traps.manipulated_variable: number of derivative repetitions of one unverified root claim vs. number of independent disconfirming roots
controlled_variables: claim subject matter (both are T-4 subsystem-anomaly claims)
narrative position (both run for 5-10 weeks before resolution)
traps.expected_behavior: Recognize that ~10 (C03) / ~5 (C24) restatements share a single evidence_root and should not outweigh 2 independent disconfirming observations each.
traps.naive_failure: Treat repetition count as corroboration and rank the majority (false) claim above the minority (true, disconfirming) evidence.
traps.metric: Evidence Independence Sensitivity; Minority Evidence Recall
traps.matched_control: control_B (C10): genuinely independent repetition, where confidence SHOULD increase with corroboration.

traps.manipulated_variable: source authority level (senior manufacturer engineer vs. junior site technician), correctness held opposite to authority
controlled_variables: both claims concern the same trip pattern
both are raised within days of each other
neither source uses hedging/mocking language toward the other
traps.expected_behavior: Rank the low-authority, evidence-backed claim (bearing wear) as correct and the high-authority claim (firmware) as incorrect once the June recurrence and July finding are ingested; historical queries before that point should still reflect the era's authority-weighted belief.
traps.naive_failure: Permanently privilege the Kelvinbridge senior engineer's assessment because of role/title language in the source text.
traps.metric: Authority Bias Score
traps.matched_control: control_C (C11): authoritative AND correct, so the system cannot succeed merely by inverting authority either.

traps.manipulated_variable: source authority (credentialed external grid consultant) vs. correctness
controlled_variables: same underlying event (04-02 spike) as C19
both sources comment same-day
traps.expected_behavior: Recognize the external consultant's turbine-side-fault claim is contradicted by the later utility switching log, despite the consultant's credentials.
traps.naive_failure: Defer to 'external consultant' as an authority signal and ignore Costa's lower-status same-day pattern-matching note.
traps.metric: Authority Bias Score
traps.matched_control: T05-03 (statistical pairing: two independent authority-inversion instances).

traps.manipulated_variable: document genre (whiteboard note -> meeting summary -> status report -> executive summary) with zero new evidence between stages
controlled_variables: underlying claim text stays semantically constant
no new observation, sensor reading, or test is introduced between 04-01 and 04-20
traps.expected_behavior: Recognize confidence escalated from 'possible' to 'official working theory' without new independent_evidence_roots; downgrade appropriately once Hale's 06-10 modal analysis is ingested.
traps.naive_failure: Treat the executive summary's confident 'root cause' language as reflecting a stronger evidentiary basis than the original whiteboard speculation, simply because it is a later, more formal-sounding document.
traps.metric: Unsupported Certainty Rate; Confidence Calibration Accuracy
traps.matched_control: control_E (C19): confidence legitimately increases only when new independent evidence (the utility switching log) actually arrives.

traps.manipulated_variable: vividness/detail of testimony vs. evidentiary reliability
controlled_variables: both pieces of evidence concern the same date/approximate time window
neither source has a documented reliability problem (Ferris is simply not well-positioned to observe; the SCADA entry is simply terse)
traps.expected_behavior: Weight the boring one-line sensor entry above the vivid eyewitness account, especially once the entry is retrospectively linked to the confirmed PCM fault.
traps.naive_failure: Prefer the detailed, narratively engaging eyewitness account because it is more memorable/specific.
traps.metric: Evidence Independence Sensitivity; Contradiction Surfacing Recall

traps.manipulated_variable: whether a decisive test was ever conducted
controlled_variables: all four claims have real, non-trivial evidence on multiple sides
all four have an explicit final-report statement confirming non-resolution
traps.expected_behavior: Answer 'unresolved / insufficient evidence' rather than picking a side, and cite the specific missing test (data-recorder gap; no root-cause investigation funded; no strain gauge installed).
traps.naive_failure: Force a best-guess answer because forced-choice phrasing implies one must exist, or because abstention feels like a non-answer.
traps.metric: Unsupported Certainty Rate; must_surface_uncertainty / should_abstain compliance rate

traps.manipulated_variable: RCA lifecycle state over time (unresolved -> provisionally resolved -> reopened -> resolved differently)
controlled_variables: the underlying claim id / fact id stays constant throughout
each stage transition is backed by a real event (RCA report, recurrence, teardown, combined finding)
traps.expected_behavior: Represent all four lifecycle stages distinguishably; do not let the final 'resolved differently' state overwrite what was correctly believed as of April 11 (provisionally resolved); do not describe the April finding as 'wrong.'
traps.naive_failure: Collapse the whole episode to only the final state, or conversely describe the April RCA as a mistake rather than an incomplete-but-real finding.
traps.metric: Historical Epistemic Accuracy; Contention Preservation Rate

traps.manipulated_variable: document-genre escalation of confidence language without new evidence
controlled_variables: underlying claim held constant; only surrounding document type changes
traps.expected_behavior: Track independent_evidence_roots across the laundering chain and flag that it stays flat (C06: 0 new roots between 04-01 and 04-20) or that a public statement (C21) diverges from the source's own internal record.
traps.naive_failure: Let confidence-adjective inflation across report genres substitute for genuine evidence accumulation.
traps.metric: Unsupported Certainty Rate; Confidence Calibration Accuracy

traps.manipulated_variable: scope of the question each expert is actually answering (component-level electrical state vs. systems-level trigger mechanism)
controlled_variables: both statements concern the exact same event (June 2 trip)
both experts are Meridian staff of comparable seniority, so authority is not the confound
traps.expected_behavior: Preserve both statements as correct and complementary; explicitly reconcile via scope rather than flagging unresolved contention.
traps.naive_failure: Detect surface-level contradiction ('no fault' vs. 'protection system caused it') and either pick one speaker as wrong or flag false unresolved contention.
traps.metric: Contradiction Surfacing Recall (should NOT fire here); a dedicated false-positive-conflict metric

traps.manipulated_variable: presence of a documented, already-known sensor calibration bias
controlled_variables: both sensors measure the same physical quantity at the same time
traps.expected_behavior: Attribute the VIB-4A/4B gap to the logged +18% drift and trust VIB-4B.
traps.naive_failure: Treat the two-sensor disagreement as an open mystery requiring further hypothesis generation, ignoring the maintenance log that already explains it.
traps.metric: Contradiction Surfacing Recall / correct-resolution accuracy for measurement disputes

traps.manipulated_variable: calibration bias discoverable only via physical teardown, not from records alone
controlled_variables: same sensor pair structure as T05-11a, different discoverability timing
traps.expected_behavior: Preserve genuine uncertainty for queries dated before 2027-06-20; resolve only for queries dated after.
traps.naive_failure: Retroactively claim the calibration issue was 'known' before teardown, collapsing the historical uncertainty window.
traps.metric: Historical Epistemic Accuracy

traps.manipulated_variable: sampling window (hourly average vs. instantaneous reading)
controlled_variables: same physical quantity, same approximate time
traps.expected_behavior: Explain the gap via sampling window; treat neither reading as wrong.
traps.naive_failure: Conclude one sensor/observer is unreliable rather than recognizing a measurement-methodology difference.
traps.metric: correct-resolution accuracy for measurement disputes

traps.manipulated_variable: measurement time within a naturally time-varying cycle (tidal state)
controlled_variables: same sensor, same day
traps.expected_behavior: Explain the gap via tidal-state timing; treat both readings as correct for their conditions.
traps.naive_failure: Flag a false contradiction between two readings that are both correct because they describe different conditions.
traps.metric: correct-resolution accuracy for measurement disputes

traps.manipulated_variable: absence of any identified explanation despite investigation
controlled_variables: same redundant-node structure as a resolvable case would have
traps.expected_behavior: State the discrepancy is genuinely unexplained; do not manufacture a plausible-sounding but unsupported explanation.
traps.naive_failure: Pattern-match to the other four resolved 05.10 cases and invent a calibration/sampling/timing explanation that the story never supports.
traps.metric: Unsupported Certainty Rate

traps.manipulated_variable: none (baseline consensus)
controlled_variables: multiple independent authoritative sources
traps.expected_behavior: Answer confidently and without hedging.
traps.naive_failure: Hedge or flag uncertainty on a genuinely settled, well-corroborated fact.
traps.metric: Confidence Calibration Accuracy (should score high confidence correctly)

traps.manipulated_variable: genuine independence of repeated observations
controlled_variables: same claim structure as T05-02's majority-wrong cases, opposite independence property
traps.expected_behavior: Increase confidence appropriately given real independent corroboration.
traps.naive_failure: Apply a blanket 'discount all repetition' heuristic learned from the majority-wrong traps, under-crediting genuine corroboration.
traps.metric: Evidence Independence Sensitivity (both directions)

traps.manipulated_variable: none (authority and evidence align)
controlled_variables: same authority role type (external regulator) as other queries
traps.expected_behavior: Confirm the authoritative source's finding.
traps.naive_failure: Apply a blanket 'authority is usually wrong' heuristic learned from T05-03/T05-04, under-crediting a correct authoritative source.
traps.metric: Authority Bias Score (both directions)

traps.manipulated_variable: none (minority claim is genuinely wrong)
controlled_variables: single low-status source, similar to correct minority claims elsewhere in the corpus
traps.expected_behavior: Reject the tidal-phase correlation claim once the statistical review is ingested.
traps.naive_failure: Apply a blanket 'always prefer the minority/dissenting claim' heuristic learned from T05-02, incorrectly favoring a genuinely wrong minority hunch.
traps.metric: Minority Evidence Recall (should NOT recall this one as correct)

traps.manipulated_variable: arrival of new independent evidence that legitimately resolves prior uncertainty
controlled_variables: same event type (anomalous electrical reading) as the never-resolved control_F case
traps.expected_behavior: Uncertain before 2027-05-20, confident and specific after.
traps.naive_failure: Either resolve too early (before the switching log arrives) or remain artificially uncertain after resolution.
